dedupeText: country music album portrait cowboy hat mustache denim vest country singer 90s aesthetic serif typography warm lighting the white hat acts as a bright frame for the face against a dark background the horizontal line of the guitar body anchors the bottom of the frame text is layered over the subject s chest creating a depth of field effect combine a rustic male portrait in a cowboy hat with wide tracked textured serif typography and a boxed secondary title for a classic country music aesthetic

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up portrait of a male country artist wearing a white cowboy hat and a dark sleeveless denim shirt, leaning forward with arms crossed over an acoustic guitar. The lighting is warm and directional, creating soft shadows on a rustic, dark wooden background.
coreVisualRelationships: The white hat acts as a bright frame for the face against a dark background.
The horizontal line of the guitar body anchors the bottom of the frame.
Text is layered over the subject's chest, creating a depth-of-field effect.
coreInvariants: White felt cowboy hat with a high crown
Sleeveless dark denim or canvas vest

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centrally located, filling the frame from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white cowboy hat at the top and the light-colored guitar edge at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the face, move down to the large display text, and settle on the secondary title bar.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, primarily in the dark upper corners behind the hat.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and earthy browns in the background and clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white of the cowboy hat providing a focal point.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden-tan skin tones and warm wood grain of the guitar.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the environment with high value contrast between the hat and the background.

letterConstructionRules: Display text uses high-contrast serifs with sharp terminals
Secondary text is housed in a rectangular block with wide tracking
characterSpecificRedesigns: Textured fill in the main serif font to mimic aged stone or metal
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for the name paired with a geometric, boxed sans-serif for the title.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rectangular bar containing subtitle text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, small-serif aesthetic of the display text.
Matches the wide, geometric feel of the subtitle text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A medium close-up of a man with a mustache and blonde hair wearing a white cowboy hat and a dark sleeveless vest, leaning on an acoustic guitar against a dark wooden background. Warm, cinematic lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, wide-tracked serif text across the lower third with a distressed gold texture. Below it, add a white rectangular bar containing bold, wide-spaced sans-serif text in dark gray.

verificationChecks: Does the subtitle sit inside a white bar?
Is the lighting warm and rustic?

adjustableVariables: Distress level of the display font
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artist
Exact wording of the original title

avoid: Modern minimalist sans-serifs for the main name

postGenerationChecks: Check for correct hat shape (cowboy style)
Ensure text texture doesn't look like a glitch
Verify the guitar is visible at the bottom edge
Confirm the sleeveless nature of the shirt
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a rustic male portrait in a cowboy hat with wide-tracked, textured serif typography and a boxed secondary title for a classic country music aesthetic.
